fusions.name: Drilled Broadside
fusions.desc: Looses 4 bolts at once, spread apart out to 8 tiles, each dealing 25 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Stolen Wind
fusions.desc: A cut that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 35% chance to leave it [Stalled] for 4 seconds. For 2 seconds after, you move 10% faster.

fusions.name: Ready About
fusions.desc: Puts you about 3 tiles from where you stood and clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Sea Legs
fusions.desc: After you cover enough ground, your next strike gains 20% critical hit chance. Once every 10 seconds. You also have 5% more dodge chance.
